author: Rainstruck
body:
So its been about two years since I first joined and to be honest, I've missed it a lot in the last couple months


 
I left in May of this year because I had a lot of personal things going on and I couldn't really find time to do things like play games frequently. If you would like to see some of the things that I have been working on on here is a couple of links that can show you what I've been doing.

I've been working on doing a lot of tournaments for a game called Splatoon. Some of you may know the game, and some may not but I've been running them offline since the game came out, and offline since a big private match update that happened a few weeks back.

Here is the current bracket for the Testfire (The biggest tournament yet): http://inkorsink.challonge.com/InkorSinkTestfireI
and here is the ruleset: http://squidboards.com/threads/ink-or-sink-tournament-v-1-1b-final-version.3564/

This is a FFA tourament that was recently just started: http://squidboards.com/threads/ios-messfest-v1-0.6589/

I also know that many of you know that I began to work at Twitter. The people that are there are fantastic and I have loved everyone that I have worked with. Since I will be going to school soon, I will be working with the a little bit less, but will still be one of the project managers for the project that I started. 

So I guess you can AMA!

P.S Its great to be back!
